verdicts.tldr: a failing Has on abciResponsesKey:0 reads as 'genesis not applied' and persists the genesis state record over a committed chain
verdicts.details: genesisApplied is `ok, err := stateDB.Has(sm.CalcABCIResponsesKey(0)); return err == nil && ok` (node.go:1123-1124), so an error is the same answer as an absent key. Every restart reaches the gate, since saveGenesisDoc drops AppState and the re-invoke branch always runs. resetToGenesisDoc then calls sm.SaveState with MakeGenesisState(freshDoc): LastBlockHeight 0, empty AppHash, no error returned. The next boot, the read error gone, loads that record and ReplayBlocks panics on StoreBlockHeight > StateBlockHeight + 1 (replay.go:395 at head), so the node needs a state repair or a resync. The trigger is a read error on that one key while the genesisDoc Get just succeeded: rare, but the outcome is a persisted write that cannot be undone. At the merge base the branch reads no extra key, and loadState panics on a Get error rather than writing. Return the Has error out of LoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider (genesisApplied as (bool, error)), which is mechanical. Same defect and same edit as candidate 1001; the round-2 decision to key the gate on the marker is untouched by it.
verdicts.evidence: finder-1 artifact rerun at head: 'returned err=<nil> LastBlockHeight=0' / 'persisted after restart: LastBlockHeight=0 AppHash=""'. It does not build at the merge base (uses head-only probeGenesisDocProvider), so the base side is 1001's artifact: 'persisted LastBlockHeight=500 AppHash="committed-app-hash"', PASS.

verdicts.tldr: TestE2ERejectThenCorrectedGenesisBoots stays green with the reset gate deleted
verdicts.details: cfg.ResetTestRoot sets DBBackend memdb (config.go:334), DefaultDBProvider calls dbm.NewDB per NewNode (node.go:82-85), and memdb's creator returns NewMemDB() each call (mem_db.go:16), so the second build starts on an empty DB and takes the first-boot branch. With node.go:1088-1090 deleted the e2e test passes while TestLoadStateFromDBOrGenesisDocProvider_RejectedGenesisRetry fails, so only the unit test pins the reset and no test runs the handshake after it. Fix shape for the author: a DBProvider returning one shared memdb per ctx.ID across both builds, or a disk backend.

verdicts.tldr: a data dir where the current release ran a rejected InitChain already carries the height-0 marker, so the corrected genesis is never picked up there
verdicts.details: Merge base replay.go:339-347 saves abciResponsesKey:0 straight after InitChainSync with no res.Error check, so a release binary that saw a rejection marked the genesis applied. On this head, genesisApplied is then true at node.go:1088 and the persisted doc stays, only AppState refreshed, so a corrected InitialHeight or validator set in genesis.json is ignored and InitChain refuses again. The merge base ignores the corrected doc too (it never refreshes doc fields), so this is not a regression; it bounds the retry path to data dirs first booted by this binary. Settled by reading those lines; the two-binary run was not built. Whether upgrade notes tell an operator to wipe such a dir is a decision for the author.

verdicts.details: The height-0 save in ReplayBlocks landed in 3aa0f0b7d (gnolang/gno#1941, 2024-07-23). A gate that also requires no committed block (block store height 0) closes this and candidates 1 and 1001 together while keeping the marker semantics round 2 chose; that is a decision for the author.
